character: Dr. Ptahsheptut Smith and Dr. Pippin Carter
voice: A sharp dispute over repatriation between an educated Egyptian advocate and an arrogant colonial archaeologist, with hostility grounded in their positions rather than ethnic caricature.

entries.text: There is still time to correct this grievous mistake, Dr. Carter. The Dagger of Amon Ra must be returned to Egypt.
Stay out of my way, or I will thrash you within an inch of your life.
Surely we can settle this without resorting to threats.
Who are you to tell me what I may do with my own property?
Your property? By what authority do you make that claim?
The Egyptian Antiquities Service authorized the excavation and division of finds. If you object, take the matter up with your own government.
I am making every effort to remain diplomatic, Dr. Carter. I suggest you do the same.
This is not a matter for diplomacy. It is a matter of accepting the facts.
My acceptance is not the only issue. Many in Egypt are furious, and some may take drastic measures if their appeals continue to be ignored.
Are you threatening me, you pompous little man?
I am warning you that people will defend their country when its national treasures are carried away.
Anyone who lays a finger on my exhibit, or threatens me, will find himself in deep trouble. Do I make myself clear?
